{{Quote|Someone's been watching me. I wasn't sure at first, but I've managed to find their camp outside of Wayfar.|[[Romo Vax]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />}}
The '''Wayfar spies''' were a group of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] based near the town of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Wayfar spies were recruited by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], to spy [[Romo Vax]]. Fortuna suspected Vax to double cross [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's organization]]. However, Romo Vax managed to lure one of Bib Fortuna's henchman and made him assassinate [[Dewall Paez]] and some other Wayfar spies.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />

The Wayfar spies were known to use [[explosive briefcase]].<ref name="SWG:WS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Wayfar Spy}} on Tatooine</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Wayfar spies appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Wayfar spies were added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
